$comment: Lycaon's own host schema. It is NOT part of the Open Agent Rules standard: the standard's vendored schemas live in schemas/oar/ and are never edited here. This one describes this engine's anchor catalog and binding grammar, which the format does not specify.
title: AnchorBindingSelector
description: Shared Binding selector vocabulary. Machine-state only — no NL heuristics. Empty / omitted clauses are permissive. Consumed by anchor-binding.schema.json and oar.schema.json via $ref.

surface.description: Emit surface. Shared vocab uses singular; OAR rules may also set profiles[] / surfaces[].

phase.description: Active workflow phase id, or null when unbound. Required scoping for many tier:workflow Bindings.

workflow.description: Workflow catalog id, or null when unbound. Workflow-scoped Binding authorship key.

tool.description: Singular tool at tool-lifecycle anchors. Prefer tools[] on OAR rules when matching a set.

tools.description: OAR multi-tool match (AND with other clauses). All listed tools are eligible; Emit supplies the concrete tool.

surfaces.description: Session/manifest surfaces (e.g. implement_investigate). Optional OAR extension of singular surface.

principal.description: Caller-identity scoping for multi-tenant adopters. Shared vocab enum or OAR string[] of api-key/team/tenant ids.

ledger.description: Typed ledger facts only — never natural language.
